title: +*INDIGENOUS ECOSYSTEM SCIENCES IN PACIFIC NORTHWEST REGIONS
description: Introduces Indigenous ancestral history and connectivity to landscape and resources. Features oral and written presentations by Native people and includes readings, charts, graphs, films and videos, offerings that are all written or produced by Indigenous peoples. Includes a concentration on use and management of cultural and natural resources, historic and contemporary impact of Treaty agreements, place-based rights, current land-use controversies, genocide, termination and restoration, trust responsibilities.
